topic: MiCA Article 23 CASP application for EU crypto issuers
script:
# MiCA Article 23 CASP Application Script

**HOOK (3 sec):**
Your crypto token launch just hit a regulatory wall—and you've got 30 days to fix it.

**PROBLEM (10 sec):**
If you're issuing tokens in the EU, Article 23 of MiCA requires CASP authorization before you trade or list. Miss this deadline and you face fines up to €5M or 10% of annual turnover—whichever is higher.

**INSIGHT (30 sec):**
Most issuers think CASP classification only applies to exchanges. Wrong. Article 23 covers *anyone providing crypto services*—including custodians, wallet providers, and brokers operating in the EU. The real trap? You need proof of compliance *before* you launch, not after. That means documenting your service model, AML controls, and operational resilience *now*. One misclassified service type and your entire application gets rejected—costing you months and six figures in rework.

**SOLUTION (20 sec):**
BizLegal-AI's **MiCA Compliance Suite** auto-maps your service offerings against Article 23 definitions, generates your CASP application package, and flags compliance gaps before submission. We handle classification, documentation, and regulatory tracking—reducing application prep time from 4 months to 3 weeks.

**CTA (5 sec):**
Run your free MiCA service assessment at BizLegal.ai—see your compliance gaps in 2 minutes.
